result.summary: Demotes Tor control port connection failure messages from warning level to debug level. This prevents repeated connection refusal warnings from filling debug.log on nodes running without a local Tor daemon.
result.problem: Since commit eae193e750, failed Tor control port reconnect attempts log warning-level messages unconditionally. On default-configured nodes where Tor is not running, this produces approximately 18 lines of log noise every hour.
evidence: "On a default configured node without tor, this pollutes debug.log with 18 lines every hour." (PR description)
result.scope_notes: The diff was not provided, but the metadata indicates a tiny 3-line change in torcontrol.
result.card: This PR demotes Tor control port connection failure logs from warnings back to the tor debug category. On default-configured nodes where Tor is not running, reconnect failures currently log multiple warning messages every reconnect attempt, generating roughly 18 unwanted lines in debug.log per hour. Moving them back to debug level silences the log spam for users not running Tor.

risk.why: A mistake only affects logging verbosity for Tor control port connection failures.
